method: Read every file in the four NFL workspaces, counted their pages and rows, tested a sample of their cited URLs against the live official site, and compared their published slate to the current Week 10 slate.

workspaces.what_it_is: Specification dashboard: singles, parlays, props, gates, leaderboard, sources.
workspaces.verified_good: Clear separation of specification from measurement; flagged unmeasured values instead of inventing them; every table row carries a source link.

findings.finding: Cites two NFL.com URLs that return 404
Uses official.nba.com as a cross-reference for NFL injury policy
No slate is dated; a reader cannot tell whether it is current

workspaces.recommendation: Freeze and banner-link to nfl-hub. Do not delete: it documents the original requirement set.

workspaces.what_it_is: Model + signals + own lines dashboard with a verification report.
workspaces.verified_good: The verification report recomputes all 32 standings rows from its game log (32 x 13 fields) and documents exactly one tie. That is a genuinely good integrity pattern.

findings.finding: Own lines stop at Week 8/9 but the pages present them without a staleness marker
No market comparison; columns are blank without a visible flag in the table

workspaces.recommendation: Keep as an archive; its reconciliation idea is reused here.

workspaces.what_it_is: Pipeline-driven measured backtest with pre-registered gates, bootstrap CIs and placebo tests.
workspaces.verified_good: Best practice in the repository: gates committed before backtests, holdout frozen, permutation tests, explicit flag list, honest 'no strategy passed' status.

findings.finding: Week 9 lines are the newest, so the published slate is a week stale
Market values are third-party and flagged, but the page still shows divergences that can read as edges

workspaces.recommendation: Cite as prior art; do not extend. This hub reuses its gate design and season splits.

workspaces.what_it_is: Lightweight strategy/validation/correlation/leaderboard pages with a test script.
workspaces.verified_good: Self-contained and small; tests its own internal links.

findings.finding: Publishes strategy candidates without measured results or an explicit 'unmeasured' badge per row
Duplicates the category set of the other three, adding reader confusion

workspaces.recommendation: Archive; the category taxonomy is reused in the hub navigation.

hub_self_review.result: 32/32 teams, all fields, including tie percentage
14/14 games matched by pairing and date; byes CHI, DEN, PHI, TB
Passed: deleting or rewriting all post-Week-9 results leaves all 14 lines identical
gates.json and strategies.json committed before results.json
Market lines, depth charts, prop values and injury causes left blank and flagged

irregularities_summary: The repository has five NFL surfaces and no canonical marker. The most serious defects are dead citations (2), a stale slate presented as current (2 workspaces), and a missing official depth-chart source. None of these blocks publishing this hub, because the hub states each limitation in place.
